# Legrand F455 (firmware 1.0.76) on the F461 test plant — live drive and direct requests, 2026-11-06 (#466)

The plant: the F461 test plant (lights `06`, `07`, `09#4#01` behind an F422, F418 dimmer `0010`,
shutter `05`, standalone thermostat zone `2`, 3550 central unit `#0`, zone `4` behind it, a 4611 IR
detector at `344`), reached through a **Legrand F455** on the same SCS bus. Every frame in these two
files was sent or received by the F455; nothing went through the F461. The F455's address and MAC,
and the MAC of the F461 the entry names as its primary, were made synthetic (`192.0.2.55`,
`00:03:50:00:11:06`, `00:03:50:00:11:07`, keeping the BTicino OUI); nothing else was changed.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `F455_full_debug_log_2026-11-06T16-24-46.log` | Home Assistant 2026.11.0 core log, `custom_components.myhome` at DEBUG, 18:24:46 → 18:28:51 local (16:24:46 → 16:28:51Z): reload of the F455 entry, `myhome.sweep_bus`, lights 06 / 07 / 09 on and off, dimmer 0010 plain ON / 50 % / 100 % / off, shutter open 6 s / stop / close, zone 2 setpoint 22.5 °C and back to 22.0 °C. MyHOME 2.0.0b17, OWNd 2.0.0b13. Kept as `.log`, like the issue_674 F455 log. |
| `F455_direct_requests_2026-11-06.jsonl` | Two runs of a command session plus an event session opened directly on the F455 with OWNd (`tools/probe.py`), 16:18Z and 16:31Z: one record per request (`kind: sent`, ACK, elapsed seconds, collected replies) and per event-session frame (`kind: event`). Status requests only; WHO 4 dimension 22, `*#16*0*5##` and WHO 13 dimensions 10 / 11 / 12 were never sent. |

## What the F455 does (direct requests)

- **Identity**: `*#13**15*200##`, firmware `*#13**16*1*0*76##` (1.0.76), uptime `*#13**19*0*5*3*21##`,
  WHO 1013 object model `*#1013**1*8*15*0*5##` (F455, code 8).
- **General status requests**: `*#1*0##` answers the four lights in 1.34 s; `*#2*0##` answers the
  shutter in 1.22 s (unlike the F459, it terminates); `*#4*0##` returns no frame and ACKs after 9.1 s;
  `*#5*0##` returns nothing and ACKs after 3.9 s (no alarm on the plant).
- **Heating, per zone**: `*#4*Z*0##`, `*#4*Z*12##`, `*#4*Z*13##`, `*#4*Z*14##` and `*#4*Z*19##` are
  answered in 0.09–0.12 s on the command session. The zone status `*#4*Z##` delivers all five frames on
  the event session but ACKs only after 8.9–9.0 s, one second short of OWNd's 10 s response window
  (the cause of the issue_674 timeouts). The central unit read `*#4*#0##` answers in 1.08 s.
- **Heating actuators and humidity**: the per-zone actuator request `*#4*Z*20##` and the all-zone
  `*#4*0*20##` are NACKed in under 20 ms, while the per-actuator form `*#4*Z#1*20##` is answered
  (`*#4*2#1*20*7##`, `*#4*4#1*20*0##`). The humidity request `*#4*Z*60##` is NACKed.
- **Lighting**: the OFF dimmer answers the dimension-1 read with the dimension-4 form
  (`*#1*0010*4*100*2##`), as the F454 and F459 do.
- **No ACK within OWNd's 10 s window**: `*#2*05*10##` (shutter position, 9.93 s) and the energy reads
  `*#18*51*51##` / `*#18*51*113##` (10.0 s each; no meter on the plant).
- `*#25*344##` (the IR detector's state) is ACKed with no reply.

## What MyHOME does with it (debug log)

- The entry is configured on a **shared bus as `standby`** of the F461 (whose entry was not loaded),
  so MyHOME skips every startup general request (`Skipping WHO=1/2/4/5/16/18 discovery: follower
  gateway on shared bus`) and prunes its entities "in favor of primary gateway" even though the
  primary is not running; `myhome.sweep_bus` sends only WHO 13 / 1013 reads.
- Climate on the F455: the zones send only `*#4*#0##`, `*#4*Z*11##` and the refused `*#4*Z*20##`.
  No temperature, setpoint or zone-status request goes out (the F455 is neither on the zone-status
  poll nor on the temperature poll), so the standalone zone 2 has no temperature or setpoint until
  something else puts one on the bus.
- Everything sent parses: 44 of 44 inbound frames in the log and 52 of 52 event frames of the direct
  runs, identical on OWNd 2.0.0b13 and dev. MyHOME logs the WHO 1001 diagnostics
  (`*#1001*0010*11*…##`, `*#1001*01*1*151*5*0*0##`) as `Unsupported message type` at DEBUG.
- Dimmer: a plain ON is echoed `*1*10*0010##` with `*#1*0010*1*200*4##` (memorised level 100 %);
  level writes go out as `*#1*0010*#1*150*0##` / `*#1*0010*#1*200*0##` and are echoed with speed 4.
- Zone 2 setpoint write `*#4*2*#14*0225*3##` is echoed as `*#4*2*12*0225*3##`, `*4*0*2##` and a fresh
  temperature; the restore to `0220` likewise.
